ns2:section.sectionText: Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 26, 2019. MCB 252 discussion sections will not meet the week of Sept. 2, 2019. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 24, October 15, and November 12, 2019. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is assessed on and non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
